name: Haus Rosmarie
beschreibung: The Haus Rosmarie welcomes visitors to sunny Wiesenweg in Neustift im Stubaital, framed by the soaring backdrop of the Stubai Alps. Styled in an inviting Tyrolean country fashion, the comfortable guest rooms provide modern en-suite bathrooms, cable TV, free Wi-Fi, and private balconies showcasing unobstructed views towards the snow-covered head of the valley. A rich breakfast buffet laden with farm-fresh local produce sets guests up for memorable days outdoors. The ski bus stops within easy walking distance, offering regular connections to the Stubai Glacier as well as the Elferbahnen and Schlick 2000. In summer, gentle riverside walks along the Ruetz and high-altitude climbs start right around the corner.
kurzbeschreibung: Family-run guesthouse on Wiesenweg in Neustift im Stubaital offering balcony rooms, Wi-Fi, and quick links to the Stubai Glacier.
